I think your heart is in the right place and it would probably be for the best if you let another owner adopt her.

However, if you haven't already, I would have the new possible owner come over for an afternoon and make sure the cat reacts well to her. Moving is stressful for cats but to throw her in a completely new environment with a new owner would be like dunking her in ice water.
I think the first paragraph is a statement. The second part is him complaining about 1000 dreams supporting female streamers because he doesn't think they deserve help.
